name: CRTS III slab track
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中研究的CRTS III型板式无砟轨道结构。
usage_overview: 指包含预制轨道板、自密实混凝土层和混凝土底座等的板式无砟轨道，以自密实混凝土替代早期板式轨道中的CA砂浆填充层。用于列车—轨道耦合动力分析，考察温度变形、层间接触对列车通过响应的影响，也用于不同轨道结构的对比。

complete_examples.text: The parameters of the CRTS III slab track–subgrade sub-model are listed in Table 2.
A high speed train–CRTS III slab track–subgrade coupling dynamic model is established.
Since 2010, many high-speed railways in China have adopted the CRTS III slab track due to its high performance.
Thus, a simplified 2D train-CRTS III slab track on subgrade coupled dynamic model is adopted in this study.
The CRTS III slab track consists of rail, fasteners, prefabricated slab, self-compacting concrete (SCC), and concrete base (Figure 3(c)).
The cross-level irregularity of CRTS III slab track is significantly smaller than that of the P-PRBT, with a maximum value 10.67% ~ 12.92% of that in P-PRBT.
